entries.name: s1_jungle_tank__idle_intact__01-08.png
entries.prompt: Edit the supplied production sprite strip. It contains EXACTLY EIGHT copies of the approved Bullets of Fury JUNGLE HEAVY TANK. Deliver EXACTLY EIGHT frames in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, equal-width cells, left to right, real transparent RGBA, wide canvas, no wrapping into a second row. Preserve this exact vehicle, existing downwards-facing barrel (toward BOTTOM of image), centered vertical centerline, original olive/tan camo pattern, dark outline, worn brass details, two antennas and hatch. Preserve the size, proportions, lighting, silhouette, hull panels, turret, barrel position and angle in ALL eight cells. This is an IDLE/CRAWL LOOP, no firing, no flash, no gun rotation, no barrel recoil. Only animate moving parts: tread links advance downwards 1-2 native pixels each successive frame around the two tracks; very subtle engine-deck heat flicker confined inside rear vents; antenna tip moves at most 1 native pixel, hull suspension rises at most 1 pixel. Frame8 returns smoothly to Frame1. Existing hull/camo pixels should match the reference closely. The main hull and gun remain the same stationary plate in every frame; animation must come from treads, not rotation or changed drawing. Maintain generous genuine transparent space around/between each vehicle, no ground shadows, no halos, no checkerboard, no text, no numbers, no borders. Crisp reference-density 16-bit arcade pixel art. DO NOT redesign, rotate, reverse facing, add arms/parts, replace the tank, or introduce scenery.

entries.name: s1_jungle_tank__fire_intact__01-04.png
entries.prompt: Edit this FOUR-frame reference canvas to make the firing animation of this EXACT approved Jungle Heavy Tank, Bullets of Fury. EXACTLY FOUR frames in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, equal cells, actual transparent RGBA. Keep the existing downward-facing barrel pointing to BOTTOM, hull, two antennas, turret, olive/tan camouflage, worn detail and lighting identical, no rotation or redesign. Same center, scale and stationary hull in every frame. Four poses: 1 shot fires with bright compact yellow/orange muzzle flash at the bottom barrel opening; 2 flash smaller and barrel alone recoils 3-4 native pixels back UP toward turret (hull/turret stay fixed); 3 flash completely gone, barrel halfway forward restoring; 4 barrel fully restored exactly to original idle, no flash. Flash is anchored at the moving barrel mouth, never at the hull center; allow transparent padding below to keep flash uncropped. Only barrel/recoil/flash changes, tread/camo/hull remains like the supplied sprite. No purple halo, no shadow, no background, no checkerboard, text, labels or borders. Crisp production 16-bit pixel clusters matching source, not concept art. Four clearly distinct firing phases with fixed registration.
